title: Episode 515: Stop Coding, Start Architecting: How AI Is Reshaping the BC Developer Role

chapters.title: 2026 wave one features and agent preview
Developer tools and open source projects

Quality improvement and testing across extensions

Tool selection, benchmarking, and team workflow management

features.name: Agent preview and agent playground
features.description: Build agents in sandbox environments and export them to use in code. Allows creating agents visually in Business Central.
caveats: Only in preview stage
Code generation from visual agents not yet automatic

features.name: Unified interfaces for AI
features.description: Code units and interfaces for working with AI inside Business Central through a unified approach.
caveats: Still in evolving stage
Cannot pass files and work with them efficiently
Some limitations and challenges

features.name: Enable troubleshooting MCP server for AL
features.description: MCP server functionality for AL development to help with troubleshooting and debugging.
caveats: Scheduled for May 2026

features.name: AL tasks from Visual Studio Code
features.description: AL development tasks integrated into Visual Studio Code for improved workflow.

features.name: Data Editor tool
features.description: Open source tool for managing and editing data in test environments. Available on GitHub and AppSource with over 160 stars and almost 1000 AppSource installs.
caveats: Solves problem of data management that was removed after BC 14

features.name: Parallel Task Worker
features.description: Open source library for developers to split large slow processes into chunks and run them in separate sessions, improving performance of long-running operations.
features.status_evidence_quote: recently I released um parallel task worker. It's like a library for developers uh where you can able to uh easily to split some

features.name: AI-assisted code generation for AL
features.description: AI can generate code and create products without spending much time writing specific lines of code, allowing developers to focus on architecture and design rather than manual coding.
caveats: Developers still need to read and understand generated code
Quality issues can arise when too much code is generated without review
Code ownership and understanding is diminished when not written by the developer

features.name: Business Central MCP
features.description: A tool that allows agents to manipulate data inside Business Central, enabling simplification of processes and improving code quality through proper tooling.
caveats: Requires proper configuration and usage to improve code quality
Not for production use; only for sandboxes or Docker environments

features.name: AI-generated test creation for AL
features.description: AI can generate tests for AL code, which was previously difficult to convince clients to invest in. Tests are now considered standard and can be generated easily with AI assistance.
caveats: Developers should understand how tests work
Tests need to be proper and fail/pass correctly
Not always easy to come up with all test scenarios

features.name: TDD approach for AL with AI
features.description: Test-Driven Development is recommended as a great choice for AL development with AI, where developers can start from tests to ensure correctness before developing functionality.
caveats: Requires developer discipline to follow TDD practice
AI can help but does not replace developer decision-making

features.name: AI-generated test suggestions and creation
features.description: AI can analyze existing code and tests, suggest additional test scenarios that may not have been originally considered, and automatically create comprehensive test suites following project conventions like Gherkin scenarios.
caveats: AI may occasionally make mistakes in test creation
Tests must still be reviewed for correctness
Works best with instruction files and existing code structure

features.name: Automated testing for production code safety
features.description: Automated tests are critical for identifying issues in production code, especially when extensions are modified or added, preventing unintended side effects in related functionality.
caveats: Tests require proper setup to be effective
Not all user scenarios can be predicted in advance

features.name: AI-assisted documentation creation
features.description: AI can help create documentation alongside development, reducing the manual effort previously required and making documentation a standard part of deliverables alongside code and tests.
caveats: Clients may not perceive documentation as direct value

features.name: Quality improvement through AI-assisted CICD and best practices
features.description: When properly configured with CICD pipelines and best practices, AI-assisted development can actually increase code quality beyond what was achievable in the past through faster generation combined with comprehensive tests and documentation.
caveats: Requires proper process configuration and discipline
Best practices must be followed consistently

features.name: Testing for Internal and External Extensions
features.description: Testing applies to all extensions whether delivered by partners, contractors, or internal development teams. Multiple extensions should be tested together to avoid conflicts and ensure existing code is not impacted.
caveats: applies to all extension scenarios
testing multiple extensions together is recommended

features.name: AI Challenges in Collaborative Development
features.description: When collaborators use AI without understanding best practices or proper context, the quality of work can suffer. This is especially problematic in open source projects where low-quality AI-generated pull requests overwhelm maintainers.
caveats: occurs when proper context is not provided
lacks understanding of AI usage
not following best practices

features.name: AI-Assisted Planning Mode
features.description: Before generating code, developers should start with planning mode, asking AI to plan the solution rather than code immediately. This involves providing full context about the problem, specific objects involved, and communicating with the AI as if it were a person.
caveats: requires providing comprehensive context
requires communicating specific related objects
must highlight why those objects are relevant

features.name: Context Window and Session Management
features.description: Proper context management is critical when working with AI agents. Developers must balance providing sufficient context without overwhelming the model. Multiple sessions should be used for different tasks to avoid losing focus.
caveats: balance between too little and too much context
context window limitations
multiple sessions needed for different tasks

features.name: AL Development Benchmarking
features.description: Microsoft released a BC bench for agents, though only two agents were counted. Developers should evaluate different AI tools themselves over time, as the relative performance of tools like Cursor, Codex, Cloud Code, and Copilot changes constantly.
features.status_evidence_quote: Microsoft released a BC bench for agents. And they it was as I remember they only count two agents, Cloud Code and maybe Codex
caveats: BC bench only covers two agents
benchmarks are mostly based on C#, Python and other languages
performance changes over time
requires personal evaluation

features.name: Individual Communication Style and AI Output
features.description: Each person has a unique communication style that affects the output from AI models and agents. Different tools and frameworks may work better for different people and tasks, and results vary based on how one communicates with the model.
caveats: highly subjective to individual communication style
no universal best tool for all users

features.name: Source Control and Code Review Workflow
features.description: What matters most in team development is not which AI tool was used, but the quality of output and how development is managed through source control, branching, merging, and code review processes. These practices maintain consistency regardless of tools used.
caveats: assumes proper source control practices are in place
requires code review discipline

features.name: AL-Go free tool for CI/CD
features.description: AL-Go is a free tool that runs in GitHub for implementing CI/CD processes. It automates testing, linting, compilation, and project building to prevent regression bugs and manage multi-developer workflows.
caveats: There could be a cost to GitHub runners depending on project setup
Requires discipline in managing branches

features.name: MCP protocol for AI communication
features.description: MCP is a protocol that allows AI agents to communicate with and change external services like Business Central, browser MCP, or run Business Central pages and click buttons directly.
caveats: Business Central MCP not recommended for production use, only for sandbox or Docker environments

features.name: Copilot in Visual Studio Code
features.description: Copilot is integrated into Visual Studio Code and allows developers to select different AI models including Anthropic and OpenAI models. It serves as a good starting point for developers new to AI-assisted development.

features.name: Command-line AI agents
features.description: Command-line agents are independent from IDE and can run inside terminal. They work more efficiently with file system and batch/PowerShell commands than IDE-based agents. Examples include Copilot agent, Codex from OpenAI, and Claude from Anthropic.
caveats: Different agents perform differently and tools are changing rapidly

features.name: Cursor IDE
features.description: Cursor is a fork of Visual Studio Code with integrated AI models. It was used early in AI development journey but is now less necessary as AI capabilities are available in standard Visual Studio Code.
caveats: Now considered unnecessary as Visual Studio Code has integrated AI capabilities

features.name: MCP in Practice
features.description: The importance of practicing MCP implementation beyond just reading theory to understand how it can provide valuable output for developers.

features.name: Business Central Development Tools
features.description: The platform continues to add development tools to assist from the development point of view, reinforcing that pure coding days are gone.

features.name: AI-Assisted Development with Architecture Review
features.description: Developers need to understand the application and architecture to work with AI, and must review and understand what AI generates rather than blindly accepting it.
caveats: developers must understand and review generated code
architecture knowledge is required

features.name: Business Central Constrained Framework Development
features.description: Business Central is a predefined application with constraints that developers must work within, making it critical to understand the framework to review generated code and deliver quality solutions.
caveats: standalone application with fixed framework

features.name: Business Central Functionality Understanding Requirement
features.description: BC developers must understand basic functionality, how it works from a business perspective, configuration options, and different use cases across business types - not just coding skills.
caveats: required for building efficient solutions

features.name: Research Before Coding Approach
features.description: Developers should research whether functionality already exists in Business Central before coding custom solutions, as many features may already be built-in standard functionality.

features.name: AI Enables Architecture and Functionality Focus
features.description: With AI handling more coding tasks, developers now have more time to focus on architecture and understanding Business Central functionality, making these skills even more critical.

features.name: Quality Delivery in Shorter Timeframe
features.description: The outcome of using AI tools and freed-up time should be delivering better quality solutions in a shorter period of time rather than just reducing work hours.
